messages:
maria: heads-up: noticed a latency regression on INT4 path after the kernel-pick change we merged yesterday. only shows up for long sequences (>512) on Ampere nodes.
kevin: thanks, any numbers? is this sm86-only or also sm80/sm90?
dan: microbench attached, ran on a100 (sm86) and h100 (sm90). sm90 is fine, sm86 is the one regressing.
kevin: ok so per-arch issue. could be the heuristic that switches to the fused-int4 kernel for seqlen>256. maybe the fused kernel has bad memory layout for long KV chaining.
maria: here's the microbench output i ran: 
```
./microbench --model vicuna-13b --dtype int4 --seqlen 1024 --batch 1 --iters 300
# node: a100-sm86
p50: 26.4ms
p95: 38.7ms
baseline (pre-swap): p95 31.2ms
```

bench-bot: perf-metrics: regression +24% p95 for int4 seqlen=1024 on sm86; throughput drop ~18%.
cheng: can you paste the kernel selection log? autotuner trace should show which signature matched.
maria: pasted below — looks like signature: arch=sm86, seqlen_bucket=1024, batch=1 -> pick: int4-fused-gemm-v3. fallback: int8-gemm.
kevin: that fused-gemm-v3 was optimized for short kv-chains and large batch, guess we misapplied for long single-batch.
kevin: two quick mitigation ideas: (1) add a seqlen hysteresis so we don't flip picks near thresholds, (2) per-arch override to prefer int8 path for sm86 when seqlen>512 until we repro and fix kernel.
cheng: also add a quick runtime check in the picker: if kv_chain_length > 4 && cache_miss_rate > 0.2 then prefer int8. that matches empirical behavior.
dan: i prototyped a heuristic script: 
```
if seqlen >= 512 and arch == 'sm86' and kv_stats.cache_miss_rate > 0.15:
    prefer_kernels = ['int8-gemm', 'fp8-fallback']
else:
    prefer_kernels = autotune_pick(default)
```
Works on my local run — p95 back to 32ms.
maria: nice. can we make the autotuner persist a per-arch signature so it doesn't re-autotune every deploy? last time we re-autotuned we got different picks across clusters.\eke: (typo)
kevin: yes — add per-arch persistent profile + versioned signature. also add a metric to Console: kernel_pick{arch,seqlen_bucket,kernel} so we can chart flips.
maria: i'll open a small PR to add hysteresis + per-arch override and flag it behind runtime config. will add unit microbench that runs seqlen=256/512/1024 so we catch regressions.
cheng: also add a nightly job to run the microbench across arch families and capture p95 time series. bench-bot can upload artifacts.
bench-bot: scheduled nightly microbench job for arch=[sm80,sm86,sm90] seqlen=[128,512,1024], dtype=[int4,int8,fp8]. artifacts will be in /bench/artifacts/1765007890-regression-check.
kevin: one more thing: we should tweak the autotuner exploration budget for sm86 int4 path. it currently tries too many kernel candidates and picks a locally-optimal for short windows. limit to candidates that pass a long-kv stress test.
maria: agreed. i'll add stress test step to autotuner harness: repeat sequence with kv-reuse pattern for 100 iterations and measure tail latency.
deploy-bot: rolling config flag enabled on canary clusters per request from @maria. will monitor for 30m post-deploy. :eyes:
maria: thanks. will follow up with PR link and perf numbers.
kevin: after this we should add a short doc to eng-runtime/wiki describing per-arch pick pitfalls so new contributors don't reintroduce it.
maria: adding to backlog. ending thread for now, will ping when PR lands.
